prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: surgical brand-mark correction in a high-fidelity 16:9 desktop website UI mockup
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target, the current VEEMAP homepage comp. Image 2 is the authoritative logo-symbol reference.
Primary request: Change only the small logo symbol at the extreme top left of Image 1, immediately before the unchanged “VEEMAP” wordmark. Replace the current black/orange V-shaped symbol with a faithful, recognizable miniaturization of Image 2: one large orange upward outer chevron nested around one smaller bright-green upward inner chevron, separated by clean white negative space, with crisp thin black outlines. Preserve the exact angular proportions and nested relationship of Image 2 while fitting it inside the existing symbol footprint in the navigation rail.
Invariants: Preserve the “VEEMAP” wordmark exactly as rendered. Keep the exact 16:9 crop, canvas, navigation boundaries, headline, supporting line, CTA, STEP 01 label, VISION/MOTION/CONTROL inventory, 1:1 callout, exploded machine, orange-red mechanism, safety-yellow marker, typography, paper texture, spacing, line weights, and all other pixel-level composition decisions unchanged.
Color constraint: The new logo symbol uses the orange and green from Image 2. Do not introduce green anywhere else and do not recolor any other element.
Avoid: changing or redrawing the VEEMAP wordmark; changing any text; changing crop or layout; moving the navigation rail; altering machinery; adding objects; changing colors outside the tiny logo-symbol area; watermark.
